Community Guidelines

Effective: August 2026

Unigram is a space for CRSU students to connect, share, and help each other. These guidelines exist to keep it safe, respectful, and useful for everyone.

✅ Do's

  • Share helpful academic resources, notices, and updates
  • Be respectful in discussions — disagree with ideas, not people
  • Report inappropriate content using the 3-dot menu
  • Use your real university information for account verification
  • Give credit when sharing others' work

❌ Don'ts

  • Harass, bully, or threaten any student or faculty member
  • Share hateful content based on religion, caste, gender, or ethnicity
  • Post explicit, sexual, or pornographic content
  • Reveal personal information of others without consent (doxxing)
  • Spread misinformation or fake notices
  • Impersonate other students, faculty, or university officials
  • Use the anonymous feed as a tool for targeted harassment
  • Post spam or repetitive promotional content

🎭 Anonymous Feed — Special Rules

The anonymous feed exists so you can share honest thoughts without social pressure. However:

  • Your identity is stored internally and accessible to admins for moderation
  • Anonymity does not exempt you from these guidelines or legal consequences
  • Using anonymity to harass specific individuals will result in an immediate ban

🛡️ Moderation

Our admin team reviews reported content. Violations may result in:

  • Content removal
  • Temporary suspension
  • Permanent ban
  • Reporting to university authorities for severe violations

📬 Report Content

Use the 3-dot menu on any post to report it. For urgent matters, email grievance@unigram.app.
